label: Calder Falls
summary: A quiet mountain town where you keep waking up on the same Tuesday. At 11:42 at night, someone dies, and the day starts over.

world.era: Present day, one Tuesday in October
world.setting: Calder Falls, a small mountain town with one diner, one motel and one very long Tuesday
world.description: In Calder Falls it is always Tuesday, the 14th of October. The diner serves pumpkin pie, the high school has a football game, a storm rolls in at nine, and at 11:42 someone dies. Then you wake up in your motel room at 6:00 and it is Tuesday again. Nobody else remembers. Yet.
rules: The day repeats; only you remember, and what you learn carries over
People do the same things unless you change something
The loop has rules, and discovering them is part of the story
Small choices can change everything by midnight
